content:
**Photosynthetic** is an Endurance-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Health regeneration between 6:00 a.m. and 6:00 p.m.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★ | 2 | Gain improved Health regen between the hours of 6:00 a.m. and 6:00 p.m. | 002DB86D | 
| ★ | 1 | Gain Health regen between the hours of 6:00 a.m. and 6:00 p.m. | 002DB86C | 

The perk only takes effect outside of combat.
